concerns.text: FR-002 requires collecting ratings from a minimum number of participants determined by power analysis. T009 (power analysis) and T009b (visualization) are marked incomplete/missing. Without T009 completing, the target N is undefined, leaving FR-002 unimplementable and T014/T015 unable to enforce the constraint.

FR-005 requires a sensitivity analysis with at least three alternative multivariate definitions of 'Cue Intensity'. T027 (defining these definitions) is marked incomplete due to missing `data/processed/sensitivity_definitions.json`. This absence renders T028 (sensitivity engine) and T029 (re-execution) impossible to execute as their input file is absent.

FR-003 and SC-004 require detecting participants with negligible variance. T023 (validation check) is marked incomplete because the test file `tests/unit/test_analysis_validation.py` is truncated and the required exclusion artifact `data/processed/analysis_validation_log.json` (or specific exclusion record) is missing, leaving the verification of this critical failure mode unimplemented.

FR-004 requires Tukey-corrected post-hoc comparisons. While T024 implements this, the associated integration test T019 (`tests/integration/test_lmm_pipeline.py`) is marked as missing. There is no verified end-to-end evidence that the LMM pipeline correctly executes the full analysis flow including post-hoc corrections.

SC-005 requires the entire pipeline to complete within 6 hours. T037a (CLI entry point `code/run_pipeline.py`) is marked incomplete with a missing artifact. This prevents the execution of T037 (benchmarking), which is the only task explicitly verifying this performance constraint.

Constitution Principle VI requires preserving consent records. T015b (consent record generation) is marked complete only in the context of T015 (real data), yet T015 is marked incomplete. The tasks lack a specific check to ensure the pipeline logic correctly toggles consent generation behavior based on the data source mode (mock vs real), creating a potential gap in compliance verification.
